FLAKY TEST IN CI: test_rapid_status_toggles

FILE: tests/unit/test_got_index_concurrent.py:156

SYMPTOM:
- Test passes locally (10/10 runs)
- Fails intermittently in CI with: "Extra data: line 18 column 1 (char 445)"
- JSON file gets corrupted with multiple JSON objects

ROOT CAUSE (suspected):
- CI environment has different timing characteristics
- Race condition in concurrent file writes manifests under CI load
- ProcessLock may not be fully protecting concurrent writes

INVESTIGATION NEEDED:
1. Review ProcessLock behavior under containerized environments
2. Check if fcntl.flock works correctly in CI runner
3. Consider adding retry logic to test or marking as flaky
4. Consider increasing test robustness with explicit barriers

WORKAROUND OPTIONS:
- pytest-rerunfailures to retry flaky tests
- Skip test in CI with @pytest.mark.skipif
- Add synchronization barriers in test

Related: T-20251226-132353-68a469de (previous race condition fix)

properties.retrospective: Implemented write-then-verify pattern in _write_with_checksum() with 3 retry attempts and exponential backoff. Test passes 5/5 locally.
